def step(s):
    m = [6, 7, 7, 7]
    res = []
    for i in range(4):
        l, r = s[(i - 1) % 4], s[(i + 1) % 4]
        d = (r > s[i]) - (r < s[i]) + (l > s[i]) - (l < s[i])
        d = 1 if d > 0 else (-1 if d < 0 else 0)
        res.append((s[i] + d) % m[i])
    return res
